propositions: Auto-deploy container restarts during in-flight code reviews cause the review to fail-close with LLM-Review -1, blocking the existing backfill reconciler recovery mechanism
The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is far shorter than the review timeout (1200s), causing reviews to be forcefully cancelled mid-execution when a deploy triggers
Transient infrastructure failures (git fetch hangs, llm unavailability, scanner errors) that occur during review are incorrectly cast as terminal fail-closed votes instead of retryable conditions
The review_attempts ledger must track consecutive retryable failures per (change_id, revision) and escalate to fail-closed vote only after N attempts (default 3) are exhausted

Retryable failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) must cast no vote to remain eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive, while terminal failures (indeterminate, finding) continue to cast fail-closed votes
